home-agents.alt: Home in the Grounded app for a team member: cards for the agents they can use (Go docs, Help Desk Assistant, HR Answers and Library Guide), each with its team and audience, and their latest conversations below.

discover-agents.alt: Discover agents: the agents a signed-in person can use, grouped by their own teams, the organisation and public.

chat-answer-with-claims.alt: A Help Desk Assistant answer to "I forgot my NetID password. How do I reset it?": numbered steps with citation chips marked with check marks, one sentence marked Uncited, the summary "5 of 6 claims supported · 1 uncited", and the two sources opened below.

chat-citation-card.alt: The same answer with a citation chip's card open: "Claim supported by this source (100% confidence)", the claim's text, the cited passage, and "Show source 1 below".

public-agent-page.alt: A public agent's page, used without signing in: the Library Guide answering "How do I book a study room?" with citations.

team-overview.alt: An IT Help Desk team's Overview for its owner: counts of data sources, knowledge bases, agents and documents; evaluation scores with one set down 17 points; spend this month against a $50 budget, not enforced; and recent changes.

data-source-web.alt: A web data source's Overview: pages crawled, passages indexed, repeated blocks removed and the next scheduled sync.

source-documents-ocr.alt: An upload source's Documents tab: status filters including Needs OCR, and its documents with kind, size, status and passages, among them a scanned PDF.

source-document-ocr.alt: The scanned PDF's record page, saying it was read with OCR (Tesseract), with the passage its text produced.

crawl-domains.alt: Data sources, Crawl domains tab: the team's domain requests with their status.

kb-try-it.alt: A knowledge base's Try it tab with Judge with SystemOne on: the question "What are the computer lab hours?", ten results, SystemOne keeping 1 of the 10 passages, and the top passage, from a scanned PDF, with its scores.

agent-build.alt: The agent editor's Build tab for Help Desk Assistant: the instructions and the collapsed Model, Knowledge, Tools, Answering, Safety and SystemOne checks sections, beside the Try it panel with a draft answer that searched the knowledge base and used check_outage, its claim summary and Add to evaluations.

agent-share.alt: An agent's Share tab: a widget key with its allowed origins, the embed code with the launcher position, and a live preview of the widget with the agent's welcome and starter questions.

agent-versions.alt: The agent's version menu in the editor header, with Version history, Compare versions and Revert draft.

agent-analytics.alt: An agent's Analytics tab, Usage view: conversations, answers, satisfaction, citations supported and refusals over the last 30 days, and answers per day.

evaluations-runs.alt: An evaluation set's Runs tab: three completed retrieval runs scoring 100%, 100% and 83%, and the score-over-time chart with markers where results per search changed.

evaluations-result.alt: A failed retrieval result: the expected document, found at #4 beyond the top 3, beside the two documents that came back, with Try this search, Open expected document and Edit question.

evaluations-answer-result.alt: A full-answer result: the agent's answer with its citations, citing the expected document, mentioning the required phrase, with all its claims supported.

team-evaluations.alt: The team's Evaluations page: two sets with what they test, their questions, latest score and trend (one down 17 points), and the Regressions filter.

team-members.alt: Team settings, Members tab: the team's only owner, an editor marked "Managed by SSO group it-staff", and two members whose roles can be changed.

team-usage-spend.alt: Team settings, Usage & spend tab: "$0.03 of $50.00 this month · Within budget · not enforced · resets Oct 1" with a meter, and the spend breakdown by agent and by model.

team-api-keys.alt: Team settings, API keys tab for a team owner: personal keys (one with only the MCP scope) and a service key with their scopes, restrictions, expiry and last use, and the Connected apps card below.

admin-overview-features.alt: Admin Overview: the platform at a glance, Needs attention with a failing connection, and the Features card listing each optional feature's state, including the MCP server and OAuth sign-in rows, with recent changes.

admin-teams.alt: Admin, Teams: every team with its approved classification, members and status.

admin-sso-groups.alt: Admin, SSO groups: one rule mapping the it-staff group to the Editor role in the IT Help Desk team, the claim read at sign-in, and how many people's last sign-in carried it.

admin-sso-groups-dry-run.alt: The Add rule dialog with its dry run: one person would be added to the team when the rule is saved.

admin-connections.alt: Admin, Connections filtered to healthy ones: a model gateway, an embedding service and a SystemOne service with their base URLs, API key hints, status and health.

admin-models.alt: Admin, Models: the Reranking notice ("Searches rerank their best 40 passages with Reranker, waiting at most 2 s. 5 published agents rerank.") with Reranking settings, and a chat model, an embedding model, a rerank model and a SystemOne model with their connection, maximum classification, what uses them, their status and health, below filters by kind, connection and health.

admin-embedding-migrations.alt: Admin, Embedding profiles, Migrations tab: a knowledge base moving to a new profile, with per-source progress.

admin-classifications.alt: Admin, Classifications: the levels Open, Sensitive and Restricted with their maximum audience and retention.

admin-moderation.alt: Admin, Moderation, Public tab: the SystemOne provider and the three Answers modes, Stream, then retract; Stream checked paragraphs; and Buffer (selected), each with what people see, above Fail closed, the block threshold for uncalibrated providers and the notice.

admin-costs.alt: Admin, Costs, Overview tab for the last 30 days: total spend, tokens (chat, embedding, SystemOne, rerank and OCR), requests, unpriced usage Yes, and spend per day by kind, with Rerank and MCP tools in the legend.

admin-costs-budgets.alt: Admin, Costs, Budgets tab: each team's mode, monthly budget, spend this month and projection.

admin-parsing-ocr.alt: Admin, Parsing & OCR: OCR turned on with the Tesseract backend and its languages.

admin-retention.alt: Admin, Retention: the retention period for each kind of data, with the Dry run, Runs and Legal holds tabs.

admin-break-glass.alt: Admin, Break-glass: sessions with their team, scope, reason, status and read counts.

admin-analytics.alt: Admin, Analytics: platform answers per day and usage totals, without message content.

audit-log.alt: Admin, Logs, Audit log: recent changes with who made them, the area and the target.

mcp-key-created.alt: Team settings, API keys: the dialog after creating a personal key with only the scope "MCP: search and ask from AI tools": the secret, shown once, and the MCP server address to give AI tools.

oauth-consent.alt: The consent page an AI tool opens: "Research Assistant wants to use Grounded as you", marked Unverified because it registered itself, with the host it says it's from and the address its answer goes to; it may search knowledge bases and ask agents in the person's teams, as them; Allow and Deny.

connected-apps.alt: Team settings, API keys: a member's MCP key and, under Connected apps, one AI tool with its host, when it was connected and last used, and Disconnect.

admin-features-mcp.alt: Admin Overview, Features: the MCP server row switched on, with the address clients use and a Setup guide link, and the OAuth sign-in for MCP clients row switched on and marked Experimental.

admin-user-connected-apps.alt: Admin, a person's page: their teams, the Connected apps card listing the AI tool they connected with OAuth sign-in, with Disconnect for platform admins, and their activity, including a search over MCP and the app signing in.

admin-mcp-servers.alt: Admin, Models, MCP servers: a Service status server with its approved tools (1 of 5), its data ceiling (Sensitive), status and health (Healthy · 8 minutes ago), with the Health filter.

admin-mcp-server-tools.alt: An MCP server record: its URL, the header shown only by its last characters, data ceiling, timeout, price per call and health, then its tools under "Read before you approve": check_outage approved, with its input schema open and the published agent that uses it, and the others not approved.

agent-build-tools.alt: The agent editor Build tab, Tools section open: the approved tool Check outage (check_outage), ticked, from Service status, approved for data up to Sensitive, with its description.

chat-tool-source.alt: A chat answer about connecting to eduroam that cites a tool result: the sources list shows "From Service status · check_outage", a tool result, beside three passages from a Wi-Fi help article.

admin-connections-health.alt: Admin, Connections with the Health column: three connections "Healthy" a few minutes ago and a backup gateway "Failing · since 8 minutes ago", with the Health filter.

admin-needs-attention-health.alt: Admin Overview, Needs attention: a domain request, "1 connection is failing" and "1 MCP server is failing", each linking to its list filtered to the failing ones.

tracing-answer-trace.alt: One chat answer as a trace in Jaeger: the HTTP request, agent.answer, retrieval (the query embedding, vector, lexical and fusion), two agent turns with their model calls, an MCP tool call (execute_tool and tools/call check_outage) with its HTTP exchanges, and SystemOne citation checks.

chat-source-viewer.alt: The source viewer beside a Help Desk Assistant answer about connecting to the VPN: "Source 1 of 2", VPN (remote access) › Connect, buttons for sources 1 and 2, four claims citing this source each marked Supported, and the document's text with the cited passage, Connect, highlighted as "Cited passage". Under the answer, the source cards read "Supports 4 claims" and "Supports 3 claims".

phone-source-viewer.alt: On a phone, the same source as a full-screen sheet: a back arrow to close it, the title and "Source 1 of 2", the claims marked Supported, and the cited passage highlighted in the document's text.

chat-source-cards.alt: An answer with five source cards under it, "6 of 10 claims supported · 3 uncited": one card reads "Supports 2 claims · 1 contradicted" in green and red, the others "Supports 2 claims" or "Supports 1 claim"; in the answer, the contradicted claim's chip has a red warning.

gaps-topics.alt: A team's Gaps page, Open tab: one topic, "Campus parking permits" for Help Desk Assistant, failed as Refused · 3 and Thumbs-down · 1, with its 8-week trend, 3 questions from 3 people, last asked 2 minutes ago.

gaps-topic.alt: The "Campus parking permits" topic's page, Open, with Dismiss, Mark fixed and Add a source: its agent, 3 questions from 3 people, 1 shared, first and last asked, the trend; why they failed, with the thumbs-down reason Missing sources; and the shared question "How do I get a parking permit for my car on campus?" with Add to evaluations.

gaps-dismiss.alt: The Dismiss dialog for a topic: How long, Dismiss for now (it reopens when new questions about it fail) or Not for this agent (it stays closed; new questions are still counted), and an optional reason, "Kept in the topic's history. Only your team's editors, admins and owners see it."

chat-feedback-share.alt: A refused answer about parking permits with its thumbs-down menu open: "Share this question with the team", ticked, above "What was wrong?" and the reasons Incorrect, Not helpful, Missing sources, Wrong sources, Outdated, Harmful or unsafe and Something else.

agent-settings-saved-answers.alt: A public agent's Settings, Saved answers: Reuse answers on ("On by default for public agents. Answers that used a tool, failed or were refused are never saved."), Also reuse answers to near-identical questions off, Reuse an answer for 24 hours, "1 saved answer now, reused once so far", and Clear saved answers.

admin-features-saved-answers.alt: Admin Overview, Features: Saved answers, On, "Agents reuse a recent answer to the same question: at once, at no model cost. On by default for public agents; each agent has its own setting.", with the Allow saved answers switch, among the MCP server, OAuth sign-in, cost tracking, OCR, SSO groups, SystemOne, public access and maintenance rows.

admin-reranking-settings.alt: The Reranking settings dialog on Admin, Models: Rerank model "Reranker", Candidates 40 (5 to 50), Time limit 2,000 ms (200 to 10,000; a slower or failed call keeps the usual order), with Save settings off until something changes.

agent-build-advanced-rerank.alt: An agent's Build, Advanced section: Reasoning effort (Default, disabled, with the Admin → Models settings Off and Low to High need), Source token budget, Minimum similarity, Rewrite follow-up questions on, Rerank passages on and Passages kept after reranking 6.

kb-try-it-rerank.alt: A knowledge base's Try it with Rerank on, for "How do I connect to the VPN from home?": "Reranked the best 40 passages in 452 ms", and results each with their rerank score, fusion score and vector and keyword ranks, the first being the second-ranked passage by vector search.

admin-moderation-reasoning.alt: Admin, Moderation, Public tab: the three Answers modes with Buffer selected, Fail closed, the block threshold and the notice, and below them the Reasoning card with Reasoning effort Low and its explanation.

admin-model-compat-thinking-off.alt: Editing a chat model, Compatibility: Output limit parameter, System prompt role, Honours tool_choice, Accepts reasoning effort, and How to turn thinking off set to Not supported (default), with its hint about Qwen3 on vLLM or SGLang, above Extra request fields (JSON).

admin-analytics-failed-questions.alt: Admin, Analytics, Top agents & teams: Top agents and Top teams, and the Failed questions card, counts only: IT Help Desk, 4 failed questions, main reasons Refused (3), Thumbs-down (1), Unsupported claims (1).

public-agent-page-thinking.alt: A public agent's page while the model reasons: the question, "Searched the knowledge base… Completed, 6 results", then "Thinking about your question…", with Stop; the footer says questions the assistant can't answer may be grouped, without the visitor's details.

public-agent-page-feedback.alt: The same public page with the answer: renewals online and how many times by borrower type, two citation chips, Used 2 sources, and the thumbs up pressed.

chat-follow-up-suggestions.alt: A Help Desk Assistant answer to "How much does colour printing cost, and how do I add money to my print account?": the prices, how to add credit and the semester print credit, Used 1 source, then "You could also ask:" with three chips: "What are the specific steps to print from a laptop?", "How do I request licensed software?" and "What technology is available in classrooms?".

phone-public-follow-up-suggestions.alt: A public agent's page on a phone: the Library Guide answering "How many books can I borrow at once as a student?" (50 items for undergraduates, 100 for graduate students), then "You could also ask:" with one chip whose question wraps onto two lines inside the screen.

agent-build-advanced-follow-ups.alt: An agent's Build, Advanced section: Reasoning effort, Minimum similarity, Rewrite follow-up questions on, Suggest follow-up questions on ("After an answer with sources, offer up to 3 questions its sources can answer. Adds a short model call after the answer."), Rerank passages on and Passages kept after reranking 6.

evaluation-set-needs-attention.alt: An evaluation set's Questions tab: "1 question needs attention" in the header, Show: All questions or Needs attention (1), and a Needs attention column saying no document in IT help articles matches "office-365-install-guide.pdf" yet.

evaluation-run-dialog-cant-pass.alt: The Run dialog of the same set: the Rerank switch and the warning "1 question can't pass: none of its expected documents is indexed. You can still start the run.", with Cancel and Start run.

agent-build-systemone-added-time.alt: An agent's Build, SystemOne checks section: Passage judging and Scope check at the platform default (off), Citation checks On with "Adds about 0.7 s per answer (platform median, last 14 days)." under it, and Citation mode Annotate.
